name: Generate Payment Schedule
Auto Calculate Term and Payment Schedule
Generate Measurement Calculation
script:
month_names = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
               "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]

sc_code = frappe.form_dict.get("sc_code")
agency_name = frappe.form_dict.get("agency_name")
from_month = frappe.form_dict.get("from_month")
from_year = frappe.form_dict.get("from_year")
to_month = frappe.form_dict.get("to_month")
to_year = frappe.form_dict.get("to_year")
source_type = frappe.form_dict.get("source_type")

from_idx = month_names.index(from_month)
to_idx = month_names.index(to_month)
from_year_int = frappe.utils.cint(from_year)
to_year_int = frappe.utils.cint(to_year)

total_months = (to_year_int - from_year_int) * 12 + (to_idx - from_idx) + 1

result = []

if total_months > 0:
    for i in range(total_months):
        idx = (from_idx + i) % 12
        year_int = from_year_int + int((from_idx + i) / 12)
        month_name = month_names[idx]

        match = []

        if sc_code:
            match = frappe.db.get_all(
                "Todd VS Sabre",
                filters={
                    "sc_code": sc_code,
                    "month": month_name,
                    "year": str(year_int)
                },
                fields=["todd_air", "todd_ndc", "air", "sc_ndc"],
                limit=1
            )

        if not match and agency_name:
            match = frappe.db.get_all(
                "Todd VS Sabre",
                filters={
                    "agency_name": agency_name,
                    "month": month_name,
                    "year": str(year_int)
                },
                fields=["todd_air", "todd_ndc", "air", "sc_ndc"],
                limit=1
            )

        air_val = 0
        ndc_val = 0

        if len(match) > 0:
            row = match[0]
            if source_type == "Todd":
                air_val = frappe.utils.cint(row.todd_air)
                ndc_val = frappe.utils.cint(row.todd_ndc)
            elif source_type == "SC":
                air_val = frappe.utils.cint(row.air)
                ndc_val = frappe.utils.cint(row.sc_ndc)

        result.append({
            "month": month_name,
            "year": str(year_int),
            "air": air_val,
            "ndc": ndc_val,
            "total": air_val + ndc_val
        })

frappe.response["message"] = result
